name: devmesh-monorepo
description: DevMesh — multi-agent AI software engineering platform (control plane + swappable agent runtimes)

scripts.build: npm run build --if-present -w @devmesh/contracts && npm run build --if-present -w @devmesh/agents && npm run build --if-present -w @devmesh/storage && npm run build --if-present -w @devmesh/workspace && npm run build --if-present -w @devmesh/runtime && npm run build --if-present -w @devmesh/opencode-adapter && npm run build --if-present -w @devmesh/server && npm run build --if-present -w @devmesh/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
